note: Support transcripts. These are the fragments the deterministic layer cannot read — corroboration or contradiction here is the LLM reasoning step's job.

transcript.text: Hi — got the rug yesterday but the colour is not what I expected. The listing looked much more red.
Sorry to hear that. Rust does photograph warmer on some screens. I can start a return — it's within the 30-day window.
Let me live with it for a week and see. I'll come back to you.
Checking in — would you still like a return label?
Tracking says delivered on the 27th but nothing arrived. I've checked with neighbours and the building office.
Thanks — I can see the carrier marked it left at the door. Let me open a trace with UPS. Give it 72 hours.
It's been four days, still nothing, and no one has contacted me. This is the second time I'm writing.
Apologies for the delay. The trace came back inconclusive. I'm going to send a replacement lamp out today at no charge.
No replacement, no tracking, no reply. I'm disputing the charge with my bank.

chats.note: No reshipment record exists in the order system for the replacement promised on 2026-03-06.

transcript.text: There's a $24 charge from you on my card and I have never bought anything from this company. Please remove it.
I can see a Restock Club subscription under hpinsky@example.com, started 14 Aug 2025. It renews monthly at $24.
That is my email but I don't remember any subscription. I certainly haven't been getting emails about it.
Our renewal notices have been bouncing back from that address since January, so it's possible you stopped seeing them. I can cancel from today.
Cancel it, and I want the last few months back. I'm calling my bank about this too.
I think I've been charged twice for the kettle. The page hung when I clicked pay so I clicked again.
I only see one order on my side (ORD-1006). Your bank may be showing a temporary authorisation that will drop off.
It has not dropped off. There are two completed charges of $75 on my statement, five days later.

chats.note: Agent's reassurance was incorrect: two settled captures exist under the single order.

transcript.text: Quick note on your order — the walnut serving tray (SKU-88, $20) is backordered until May.
Ah. Can you just send the knife and the board then? I don't want to wait until May.
Done — I've removed the tray from the order, so you'll only be charged $180 for the other two items. Nothing to do on your end.
Perfect, thanks.
The dinner set is lovely but the serving platter arrived in two pieces.
Sorry about that. The platter was $40 — I'll refund just that line rather than have you ship it back. It should show in 3-5 business days.
That works, thank you.
